What is the difference between RAM and ROM?

RAM (Random Access Memory) is volatile temporary memory that holds data currently in use by the CPU, losing its contents when powered off. ROM (Read-Only Memory) is non-volatile permanent memory that stores essential firmware instructions, such as the system BIOS, and retains data indefinitely without power.
